create_conv_nd: create a 1D, 2D, or 3D convolution module using conv_nd with the desired dimensions and channel args
create_timestep_embedding: create sinusoidal timestep embeddings for diffusion models using timestep_embedding with a specified output dimension
update_ema: update target model parameters using exponential moving average with update_ema and a configurable smoothing rate
zero_module: zero out all parameters of a PyTorch module using zero_module to initialize skip connections
checkpoint_function: reduce memory usage during training by using checkpoint to recompute activations in the backward pass
